stories.title_ja: 迷子の猫の冒険 (Maigo no Neko no Bōken)
stories.title: The Lost Cat's Adventure
stories.summary: A small, fluffy cat named Whiskers gets lost in the big city. He meets friendly people and other animals who help him find his way back home. This story uses simple vocabulary to describe places and actions.
grammar_points: ではありませんでした(dewa arimasen deshita)
